description: A comparable value that a twin product reads from its sibling's sheet (same material, same Shared formulation key, D89) is no longer counted again in the material's median, range, quartiles and typical product. The sibling's own value stands once, and the twin still counts as a product. The knock-on through the typical product reaches the estimate stage's calibration and some estimates.
ruling: Owner ruling OQ-09 A (R-OQ09d, 2026-10-20): a table one maker reprints from another counts once in a material's median; timing Q2-11 A (its own transition, after parity)
